In Boundless Roads I share travel stories and practical information about the places I visit and the nomadic lifestyle.

feeds.description: In the following section, Priyanka talks about her South American travels and stays. Hello there! I am Priyanka Gupta. Writing, travelling, and blogging is my way of life. I promote a sustainable, long-term travel lifestyle while travelling responsibly and supporting local endeavours.

My goal is to be the first person in history to visit every country, the North Pole, the South Pole and climb the highest mountain on every continent. I'm about 75% of the way there
